pad.title: Buffs
pad.help.row.desc: how it works, with an example for your party
pad.help.title: Help
pad.help.body:
# What it is
The menu casts buffs by group with one press. The mod picks the caster,
spends slots and skips targets that already have the buff.

# L5 button
Press — this menu. Hold 0.6 s — "{0}". Double press — "{1}".
Without the menu the result pops up at the top for 5 seconds.

# Main menu
Up/down — row. A — apply a group or open an item.
X — all shown groups in turn. Y on a group — its buffs. B — close.
A group row shows buffs, active/needed, the next expiry and how many are off.
Yellow — some buffs dropped, green — all active.
"Buffing in combat" — allow groups during combat (off by default).

# Groups and their names
A group is a set of buffs cast with one command.
Without a name of its own a group is named by the duration it is meant for.
Built-in: "10 min/level and longer" (after rest), "Minutes" (before a dangerous area),
"Rounds" (before a boss). They can be renamed and hidden, not deleted.
Your own group: Groups → "+ New group" → name → LB/RB duration → Y.
The name is typed on the on-screen keyboard: D-pad — key, A — type,
X — erase, Aa — capital, EN/RU — layout. Up to 12 own groups.
X in the group list — hide/show in the main menu. A hidden group is not part
of "all groups" and is not shown in the menu, but can still be edited.
RB twice within 3 s — delete your group. Buffs that were only in it lose
their targets; in other groups they stay.

# Group buffs
Open: Y on a group in the main menu or A in the group list. LB/RB — next group.
On top — the group's buffs with a tick. Below, in grey, the rest: buffs of the
group's duration first. Columns: name, duration, who, targets (set/possible).
A — add or remove. X — tick. Y — auto-fill. Right — buff targets.
An unticked buff is off only in this group: targets are kept, other groups
still cast it. Tick it again and it is cast again.
Auto-fill adds every party buff of the group's duration, switched off:
tick the ones you need. A group of any duration has no auto-fill.

# Self or party — automatic
Adding a buff to a group sets its targets:
— "self" — the caster can only target himself (Shield, abilities):
  everyone who knows the buff gets it;
— "party" — everyone it can target, pets included;
— songs and performances — one performer, the first in the party.
Targets are shared by the buff across all its groups. Adjust them in "Buff targets"
or with Right in group buffs; X there restores automatic targets.
If nobody in the current party can receive a buff, it is not added.
Removing the last target takes the buff out of every group.
A target given to a buff outside groups puts it into "10 min/level and longer".
A new companion gets no targets by itself: add them in "Buff targets"
or remove and add the buff again.

# Duration
Taken from the spell: rounds, minutes (min/level), 10 min (10 min/level),
hours (hours, days, permanent), toggle (activatable abilities and songs).
Without an exact duration long counts as hours, short as rounds.

# Casting
Unticked buffs are not cast. Slots go to the buffs of the group being cast first.
A buff in two groups is skipped the second time: it is already active.

# Messages
"applied X/Y, already active Z" — Y attempts, Z targets already had it.
"no caster" — casters are out of slots, rest.
"not started" — in combat while "Buffing in combat" is off.

# Where it is stored
Saved at once, per playthrough: mods/BuffIt2TheLimit/UserSettings.
Custom groups are visible only in this menu.

sort.name: Trier par nom
group.normal.tooltip.desc: Tente de lancer les sorts configurés dans la fenêtre de buff (Buffs Normaux)
group.important.tooltip.desc: Tente de lancer les sorts configurés dans la fenêtre de buff (Buffs Importants)
group.short.tooltip.desc: Tente de lancer les sorts configurés dans la fenêtre de buff (Buffs Rapides)
group.overview.more: … et {0} de plus (clic droit pour la liste complète)
showmap.tooltip.desc: Affiche la carte des îles pour choisir le prochain point de votre aventure
noarcanist: aucun point de réservoir arcanique disponible
use.reservoirclbuff: Utilisé Réservoir d'Arcaniste Buff pour NLS
use.azatazippymagic: Contrôlez le buff secondaire Azata Zippy Magic
caster.rank-tooltip: Une priorité plus élevée lance en premier. Ordre par défaut à priorité égale : groupe actif avant la réserve, sorts avant parchemins et potions, puis lanceurs à préparation avant les spontanés (niveau de lanceur le plus élevé d'abord). « Ce buff » remplace « tous les buffs » pour ce sort uniquement — une valeur grise suit la priorité globale.
caster.mount-tooltip: Affiché quand plusieurs compagnons de ce personnage peuvent être chevauchés (p. ex. un compagnon animal et Aivu adulte) — Saddle Up ne peut alors pas choisir seul. Choisissez ici la monture ; Auto ne monte que lorsqu'un seul compagnon convient.
caster.fury-tooltip: Affiché quand Shifter's Fury propose plusieurs armes naturelles (p. ex. morsure et griffes). Choisissez ici l'arme que la routine doit activer ; Auto reprend le dernier choix du jeu. Le repos reconstruit la liste d'armes et désactive Shifter's Fury — seul un choix enregistré permet à la routine de la réactiver seule.
settings-toggle: Afficher/masquer le panneau de paramètres Buff It 2 The Limit
setting-skip-combat-anim: Ignorer les animations en début de combat
setting-cast-all-combat-start: Lancer tous les buffs en début de combat
setting-cast-all-combat-start-tooltip: Au début du combat, lance automatiquement tous les buffs configurés — comme si 'Cast on combat start' était coché pour chacun. Les réglages individuels des buffs restent inchangés.
setting-bypass-asf-tooltip: Lors du pré-buff hors combat, ignore le risque d'échec des sorts profanes dû à l'armure portée, pour que les lanceurs profanes en armure lancent de façon fiable. Sans effet une fois le combat engagé.
setting-overwritebuff-tooltip: Relance les buffs même sur les personnages qui les ont déjà. Désactivé, toute cible portant déjà le buff est ignorée.
setting-verbose-tooltip: Lance chaque buff avec son animation d'incantation complète. Désactivé (par défaut), les buffs sont appliqués instantanément — bien plus rapide pour les grandes routines.
setting-umd-retries-tooltip: Quand lancer depuis un parchemin nécessite un test d'Utilisation d'objets magiques (UMD), relance un test raté jusqu'à ce nombre de fois avant d'ignorer ce parchemin.
setting-umd-mode-tooltip: Quand un personnage peut-il utiliser un parchemin dont le sort n'est pas sur sa liste de classe (test UMD) ? 'Lanceurs sûrs uniquement' : jamais. 'Autoriser si DD atteignable' : seulement si un 20 naturel peut réussir. 'Toujours essayer' : dès que le personnage a un minimum de compétence UMD, même sans chance de réussir.
setting-source-priority-tooltip: Ordre par défaut pour choisir la source de lancement quand un buff est disponible via plusieurs — sorts, parchemins ou potions. Chaque buff peut le remplacer par sa propre priorité.
setting-bypass-asf: Ignorer l'échec de sort arcanique en prébuff
openbuffs.tooltip.desc: Ouvrir directement le menu de configuration Buff It 2 The Limit
settings-clear-all-tooltip: Supprime toutes les assignations de personnage de chaque buff. Les groupes, bascules de source et autres paramètres par buff sont conservés. Nécessite deux clics.
reserve.toggle.tooltip: Show all recruited companions, including those not in the active party
use.combatstart.tooltip: Automatically cast this buff when combat begins
deactivate.after.rounds.tooltip: Automatically deactivate this ability after N combat rounds. 0 = no limit.

pad.groups.nodelete: A built-in group cannot be deleted — hide it instead (X).
pad.members.title: Group buffs
pad.members.removed.last: "{0}" left its last group, targets cleared.
pad.members.notargets: "{0}" has no target in the current party — not added.
pad.members.tick.outside: Only group buffs have a tick. Add the buff first (A).
pad.members.fill: Auto-fill: {0} added, all off. Tick the ones you want with X.
pad.members.fill.any: The group has no duration, auto-fill does not know what to take. Set it: Groups → Y.
pad.members.new: Group created. Y — fill by duration, A — add one by one.
pad.members.new.any: Group created. Add buffs with A.
pad.name.label: Name
pad.name.note: An empty name means the group is named by its duration. The Steam keyboard (Steam + X) works too.
pad.help.example.party: "{0}" is a party buff: added to a group it goes on {2} (cast by {1}). By duration it belongs in "{3}".
pad.help.example.self: "{0}" is a self buff: everyone who knows it casts it on themselves — {1}.
pad.help.example.rounds: "{0}" lasts rounds: main menu, Y on "{1}" → find it in the grey list → A.
pad.help.example.rounds.ok: "{0}" lasts rounds and is in "{1}" already: double L5 before a boss.
pad.help.example.custom: Your group "{0}", {1} buffs: main menu, Y on it → Y auto-fill → X on the ones you want.
pad.help.example.newgroup: Your own group, e.g. "Anti-undead": Groups → "+ New group" → type a name → LB/RB duration → Y.
pad.help.example.tick: Switch "{0}" off in "{1}" keeping its targets: Y on "{1}" → select "{0}" → X (the tick goes).
